dialogue.speaker: Bekzat
dialogue.text: Ainur, you can speak five languages? I can't believe it! How?

dialogue.speaker: Ainur
dialogue.text: Ha! I practise every day. I can speak Kazakh, Russian, English, Chinese, and Korean.

dialogue.speaker: Bekzat
dialogue.text: Incredible. I can only speak Kazakh and Russian. I can't learn languages — my brain doesn't work that way!

dialogue.speaker: Ainur
dialogue.text: Of course you can! It just takes time. Can you play any musical instrument?

dialogue.speaker: Bekzat
dialogue.text: No, I can't play any instrument. I tried guitar once — terrible! But I can play football. Can you?

dialogue.speaker: Ainur
dialogue.text: Ha! No, I can't play football at all. I can run, but I can't kick the ball straight!

dialogue.speaker: Bekzat
dialogue.text: I can teach you! Football is not so difficult. Can you swim?

dialogue.speaker: Ainur
dialogue.text: Yes, I can swim — I competed in regional swimming competitions. Can you?

dialogue.speaker: Bekzat
dialogue.text: A little. I can swim, but not very fast. Can you cook?

dialogue.speaker: Ainur
dialogue.text: Yes! I can make Korean dishes. Can you?

dialogue.speaker: Bekzat
dialogue.text: I can make shashlik on the grill — that's it! Can you sing or dance?

dialogue.speaker: Ainur
dialogue.text: I can sing a little, but I can't dance. I have two left feet!

dialogue.speaker: Bekzat
dialogue.text: Me too! I can't dance at all. I look like a robot at parties!

dialogue.speaker: Ainur
dialogue.text: Ha! We should join the dance club — then we CAN dance by the end of the year.

dialogue.speaker: Bekzat
dialogue.text: Good idea! I can't dance now, but I can learn. I can do anything with practice!

dialogue.speaker: Ainur
dialogue.text: Exactly! "I can't yet" is very different from "I can't ever." Remember that!

task1Items.question: Bekzat can play guitar very well.
Ainur competed in regional swimming competitions.
Bekzat can cook shashlik on the grill.
Both Bekzat and Ainur decide to join the dance club.

listenStatements.text: Can speak five languages: Kazakh, Russian, English, Chinese, Korean.
Can play football but can't play any musical instrument.
Can swim and competed in regional swimming competitions.
Can cook shashlik on the grill — and nothing else!
Can sing a little but can't dance at all.
Says "I can't yet is very different from I can't ever."
